ee AS (SELECT e.* FROM events e JOIN scope c ON e.cid=c.cid WHERE e.day>=0 AND e.day<12), a AS (SELECT cid,COUNT(*) orders,SUM(amount) revenue,AVG(CAST(amount-cost AS DOUBLE)) margin,STDDEV_POP(amount) volatility FROM oo WHERE cancelled=0 GROUP BY cid),
b AS (SELECT cid,COUNT(*) events,COUNT(DISTINCT day) active_days,AVG(CAST(value AS DOUBLE)) activity FROM ee GROUP BY cid)
SELECT c.cid,c.tier,c.credit,COALESCE(a.orders,0),COALESCE(a.revenue,0),COALESCE(a.volatility,0),COALESCE(b.events,0),COALESCE(b.active_days,0),COALESCE(b.activity,0),COALESCE(a.margin,0)
FROM scope c LEFT JOIN a ON c.cid=a.cid LEFT JOIN b ON c.cid=b.cid ORDER BY c.cid
